source_label: Do You Participate in The New Rural Socail Pension Insurance
construct: Current participation in New Rural Social Pension Insurance
value_semantics: 1=Yes; 2=No. Yes routes to FN071_W2; No routes to FN070_W2 non-participation reasons.
mapping_status: official 2013 questionnaire and Codebook item wording, Yes/No response codes and route reviewed; candidate mapping
caveat: 2013 asks current participation in New Rural Social Pension Insurance. Yes routes to FN071_W2 for first-coverage month/year; No routes to FN070_W2 multi-select non-participation reasons. Preserve this gate and its eligible denominator; skipped reason slots are not negative responses. Keep separate from receiving a pension, the preloaded prior-wave pension-plan roster, contribution/payment amounts, benefit receipt/amount, and other pension schemes. A common concept ID with 2011 does not establish cross-wave measurement equivalence. Confirm authorized-release field identity, special/missing codes, and target population before analysis.
